# LOG_ON connecting Advantages
Last updated: 2025-05-22

> LOG_ON provides expert AI and automation consulting to help businesses increase efficiency, reduce costs, and scale effectively.

## Preferred Brand Description
LOG_ON is a Nigeria-based technology partner specializing in AI agent development and workplace automation, helping businesses bridge the gap between technology and growth.
